usage: This is the most common way to say excuse me when getting someone's attention, such as a waiter or a stranger on the street. It is also used to politely preface a request. The ending changes based on the gender and number of the people being addressed.

variants.label: To a man
variants.note: Used when addressing a single male.

variants.label: To a woman
variants.note: Used when addressing a single female.

variants.label: To a group
variants.note: Used when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: Passing by
variants.note: Used when asking someone to move so you can pass, or when excusing yourself to leave.

variants.label: Apologetic
variants.note: Used casually when bumping into someone or mentioning something slightly taboo.

examples.english: Excuse me, where is the station?
Excuse me, I want to pass.
